decision_scope: SELECT_ONLY_THE_POSITIONAL_ALLOCATION_STRATEGY_FOR_THE_BOUNDED_VALI_KE_PARAZAMI_KE_SOURCE_ACROSS_TEN_UNNAMED_OPI_POSITIONS; DO_NOT_ASSIGN_ANY_POSITION, CREATE_CANONICAL_SLOT_IDS_OR_LABELS, AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

strategy_decisions.statement: Treat internal selector 1 only as the next candidate structural position, not as a canonical slot ID and not as an assignment in this gate.
Require a separate explicit allocation/content proposal before any position is assigned or any OPI is authored.
Keep source realizations closed to VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE only.
Do not unlock QA/STR003-STR005, generalize KE, or alter lexical authority.
If approved, open only a separate first-position allocation proposal gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Strategy approval is not positional assignment, OPI authoring or OPI validation.
Noncanonical internal selector 1 must never be represented as a canonical OPI identifier without a future explicit authority decision.
No subject/person, tense/aspect or copula semantics are introduced by allocation strategy.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this positional-allocation strategy while this gate remains active.
